pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with smooth, low-variance edge gradients. Spatial area is maximized on the anterior-dorsal section, with individual patches exhibiting irregular convex boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space pathways of uniform pixel thickness relative to patch size. The topological graph consists of consistent tri-radial nodes forming a stable tessellation across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude bristled silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, creating a jagged 1D geometric contour against the background.
